summary: Harden #638/#639 loop advance gates: shared evaluate_babysit_gates blocks on merge_state, unresolved threads, review_decision=CHANGES_REQUESTED, and CI failing/pending; get_pr_merge_gates exposes reviewDecision + statusCheckRollup; babysit/merge_eligible stages refuse advance until clean.
migration_impact: Bug/feature loop advance with gates= now also requires green/settled CI and no CHANGES_REQUESTED. get_pr_merge_gates returns additive fields (review_decision, ci_*, loop_advance_*). No .plate schema change.
migration_guidance: 2. When advancing loops, pass gates from plate_get_pr_merge_gates / get_pr_merge_gates (or equivalent) so CI + review decision are checked.
3. Expect advance to stay on babysit while checks pending or failing; re-tick after CI settles.
4. Human CHANGES_REQUESTED remains a hard babysit hold (address feedback before advance).
agent_notes: evaluate_babysit_gates is pure and shared — prefer it over hand-rolled merge_state checks. risk-off still never auto-merges; merge_eligible only reports readiness. Pairs with #648 checkpoints and #605 outdated thread resolve.
